name: s3GenerateURI
syntax: s3GenerateURI(bucketNameOrPath [, objectName, type, secure, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Builds an unsigned URI for an S3 bucket or object, without making a request.

params.name: bucketNameOrPath
params.description: The bucket name, or an `s3://` path to a bucket or object, such as `s3://mybucket/file.txt`.

params.name: objectName
params.description: The object key, when `bucketNameOrPath` is a bucket name.

params.name: secure
params.description: When true, an `https` URI is built. Only applies to `virtualhost` and `path`.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the `type` argument `style`, which can be `virtualhost` or `path`. Takes no credential or `timeout` arguments, so `host` is the fifth argument.

examples.title: Generate a canonical object URI
examples.description: Virtual-host style against the default endpoint.

examples.title: Path-style URI
examples.description: Builds a URI with the bucket in the path instead of the hostname.
